title: AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPICS AND PARALYMPIC GAMES COMMITTEE REPORT and ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES (APCF) COMMITTEE REPORT relative to…
text:
[Council File 15-0989-S79]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPICS AND PARALYMPIC GAMES COMMITTEE REPORT and ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES (APCF) COMMITTEE REPORT relative to incorporating the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (Olympics) into the Los Angeles Public Library’s 2028 Summer Reading Challenge.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez – Price):
REQUEST the Los Angeles Public Library to report to Council with recommendations for incorporating the Olympics into the 2028 Summer Reading Challenge.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion to bring the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games into the Los Angeles Public Library's 2028 Summer Reading Challenge.
